text: そんなん　いうても　ポケモン　もちきれへんやんけ！

structure.jp: そんなん　いうても
ポケモン　もちきれへんやんけ！
structure.en: I can't carry any more Pokémon, can I!

patterns.name: 〜ても
patterns.explanation: ても after a verb means 'even if'. いうて is the Kansai dialect form of いって. いうても = 'even if you say so'.

patterns.name: 〜きれない
patterns.explanation: きれない added to a verb means you cannot do it all the way. へん is the Kansai dialect form of ない. もちきれへん = 'can't carry them all'.

patterns.name: 〜じゃないか
patterns.explanation: やんけ is the rough Kansai dialect form of じゃないか, which pushes a point the listener should already see. もちきれへんやんけ = 'I can't carry them all, can I!'
